records.tagline: Manage all your localhost ports in one place
records.description: Every developer has had this moment: you start a new project, forget which port it's running on, and start digging through terminal tabs. Localhost Manager keeps track of all your running local servers in one clean Chrome extension popup. → Save & name your localhost ports (e.g. "React App :3000") → One-click open in new tab → Color-coded status indicators → Runs 100% locally — no sync, no accounts, no tracking → Works with any framework: React, Vue, Laravel, Django & more

records.name: Little Hero Book
records.tagline: create your custom children books, delivery within 7 days
records.description: Create personalized storybooks starring your child as the hero with the whole family. Upload photos of siblings, mom, dad, grandparents, and more to bring everyone into a fun adventure. Premium hardcover, made in the USA.

records.name: Resetlio , Track What Matters
records.tagline: better habits. No account. No data harvesting. Just you.
records.description: 14:03Most habit trackers want your email, your data, or a subscription just to get started. Resetlio is different. No account, no cloud, no data leaving your device. Ever. Live streak timers, a home screen widget, milestones, and beautiful stats. All 100% on-device. Built for people serious about habits but done handing their data to yet another app.

records.name: Imagined
records.tagline: Visualize your Dream Life with AI
records.description: Imagined is an iOS app that uses AI to generate vivid images of your dream life from a first-person perspective, as if you're already living it, along with audio of your future self narrating it back to you. Spend 5 minutes a day visualizing the version of you you're becoming.

records.name: Cartobike
records.tagline: Buy and sell used cars across France with ease
records.description: Cartobike is a modern marketplace that simplifies buying and selling used cars in France. Private sellers can easily list vehicles, while buyers explore deals through an intuitive interface. Users can browse listings, compare prices, and find cars matching their budget. With streamlined tools and direct connections, Cartobike makes vehicle transactions faster, simpler, and more reliable across France for all users nationwide every single day.!!

records.name: ShipLogr
records.tagline: Track POs, Shipments & Real Landed Cost Without Spreadsheets
records.description: ShipLogr tracks every PO, partial shipment, and landed cost per SKU — including freight, duty, and tax. Built for small manufacturers and importers.

records.name: Procshot
records.tagline: Capture browser actions, auto-generate step-by-step guides
records.description: Procshot auto-records your browser actions — clicks, inputs, page navigations — and turns them into step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots. Export as PDF, Markdown, or HTML. Perfect for SOPs, onboarding docs, and training materials. Free to try.

records.name: Saju
records.tagline: AI-powered Korean Saju destiny readings for the modern world
records.description: Description: MySajus brings 3,000 years of Korean Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) wisdom to the modern world. Enter your birth date and time to discover: ✨ Your core element & Day Master 🔮 8-section personalized AI reading 💫 Career, love, health & fortune analysis 🌟 2025-2026 fortune forecast Available in English & Korean. Don't know your birth time? No problem! Powered by Claude AI.

records.name: Best Digital Marketing Lucknow
records.tagline: digitalmarketinglucknow
records.description: Boost your business with ArikaB2B, the best digital marketing agency in Lucknow. We specialize in SEO, SMM, paid ads and more.

records.name: StyleKit
records.tagline: Extract any website's design system in one click
records.description: StyleKit Chrome Extension extracts colors, fonts, spacing and design tokens from any website and generates AI-ready DESIGN.md files for Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf and more.

records.name: UXPin Forge
records.tagline: Generate UI from your design system, not around it
records.description: AI that generates UI your design system would approve. Forge works inside UXPin with your real components—MUI, shadcn/ui, Ant Design, or your own—so you can iterate fast and ship clean JSX. No rebuilding, no workarounds.

records.name: Manna
records.tagline: Beautiful daily Bible verses on your home screen
records.description: Manna brings curated daily Bible verses to your iPhone home screen through beautifully designed widgets. Read Scripture offline in 9 languages, use bilingual mode, customize 83 themes, set gentle reminders, and unlock premium once for $4.99.

records.name: ExportPanda
records.tagline: Airtable CSV JSON XML export URLs for Google Sheets & Excel.
records.description: Turn any Airtable base into permanent CSV, JSON & XML URLs. IMPORTDATA-ready for Google Sheets, no 2,000-row cap, linked & lookup fields auto-resolved.

records.name: commanda.ai
records.tagline: Turn tables into revenue with AI-powered digital menu
records.description: Commanda.ai revolutionizes restaurant ordering with QR-based digital menus and AI-powered upselling. Customers scan, order, and pay instantly from their table—no app download needed. Restaurant owners get real-time analytics, smart recommendations that boost revenue by 30%, and automated kitchen management. Built with Next.js 14, it's blazing fast, works offline, and supports multi-language menus. Perfect for cafes, bars, and restaurants ready to eliminate wait times and maximize profits. 🚀

records.name: LVAD Gear
records.tagline: LVAD HeartMate Men’s Full Sleeves Shirt – Black
records.description: Designed for Regular wear. This LVAD HeartMate Black Full Sleeve Shirt for Men's offers a hidden driveline system & battery pockets. Order now.

records.name: The Complete Platform for Adjusters
records.tagline: Every Tool You Need. Nothing You Don't.
records.description: AI reports, license tracker, inspection forms, weather verification, mileage log, earnings tracker, CAT mode — everything an independent adjuster needs, in one place.

records.name: DarkLogger - Migraine / Headache tracker
records.tagline: Photophobia Friendly , 100% offline Migraine logger
records.description: Dark Logger is a utility-first migraine tracker. Instead of bright screens and long surveys, it features a 2-second "panic" button to log attacks instantly and a photophobia-safe, muted color palette to prevent eye pain. It silently fetches weather triggers, operates 100% offline for radical privacy, and exports high-contrast PDFs for neurologists. 🎁 Promo: The developer is offering a FREE lifetime report unlock for iOS (Android users ping the maker @zeph_llc )!

records.name: MboaCook
records.tagline: AI cooking assistant for recipes, plans, and cook mode.
records.description: MboaCook helps you turn ingredients you already have into practical recipe ideas, weekly meal plans, and guided cooking steps. Add ingredients by voice, personalize by country and taste, save recipes, reduce waste, and cook hands-free with timers and voice guidance.

records.name: brnd.ink
records.tagline: Complete Brand System in minutes.
records.description: Most AI tools stop at the logo. brnd.ink doesn't. Put in your brand name and what you do. Get a complete identity system: logo, brand guidelines, business cards, letterheads, social media templates, invoices, pitch decks, and real-world mockups. In under 5 minutes. $35 one time. Built for founders who need a brand before their next pitch. Not a logo generator. A complete brand system.

records.name: MinutesToSpare.com
records.tagline: Turn your wait time into win time — 3 missions, zero fluff
records.description: Got a few minutes to spare? MinutesToSpare.com gives you fun, productive, and silly things to do while you wait — no app needed. Free, instant, and actually enjoyable.
